name: F-1
tagline: The most powerful single-chamber engine ever flown
description: Five F-1s on Saturn V's first stage produced combined thrust that no single rocket before or since has matched at sea level. Rocketdyne's gas-generator cycle burned LOX and RP-1 at a rate that demanded turbopumps the size of car engines and a combustion chamber that engineers had to solve combustion instability in by trial, explosion, and redesign. It first flew on 9 November 1967 and put Apollo on its way to the Moon six times before the program ended.
best_known_for: Most powerful single-chamber liquid engine ever flown — five lifted Saturn V
